§6Neptunium-237§f

§aFissile, underrated, and contributes 30 to the custom nuke. The highest of any ingot.§f

Neptunium-237 is a radioisotope mainly used as fuel material, either alone or as an additive for schrabidium fuels.

Properties: §e2.5§f RAD/s, fissile, atomic number §e93§f.

Production: breed §bU-235§f in a breeding reactor, find in Desert Atom structures, or smash Lithium with natural Uranium in a Cyclotron.

Uses: §bSchrabidium Fuels§f (fuel additive), breeding into Pu-238 (breeding reactor), §bWatz Power Plant§f pellet (weak but cheap), §bRBMK Fuel§f (medium and highly enriched neptunium fuel, runs on fast neutrons), and contributes §e30§f to the custom nuke.

§ePS:§f That §e30§f contribution to the custom nuke is the highest of any ingot. Set up U-235 breeding early for a steady supply.
